data.topic: 课文1 · 1. 谈周末的打算 — Talking about the plan for the weekend

items.en: weekend
plan; to intend
particle for confirmation or defense
with
Xiaoli (name)
Xiaogang (name)

items.zh: 小丽：周末你有什么打算？
items.py: Xiǎolì: Zhōumò nǐ yǒu shénme dǎsuàn?
items.en: Xiaoli: What are your plans for the weekend?

items.zh: 小刚：我早就想好了，请你吃饭、看电影、喝咖啡。
items.py: Xiǎogāng: Wǒ zǎo jiù xiǎnghǎo le, qǐng nǐ chī fàn, kàn diànyǐng, hē kāfēi.
items.en: Xiaogang: I figured it out long ago: I'm treating you to dinner, a movie and coffee.
Xiaoli: Treating me?

items.zh: 小刚：是啊，我已经找好饭馆了，电影票也买好了。
items.py: Xiǎogāng: Shì a, wǒ yǐjīng zhǎohǎo fànguǎn le, diànyǐngpiào yě mǎihǎo le.
items.en: Xiaogang: Yes, I've already found a restaurant, and I've bought the movie tickets too.

items.zh: 小丽：我还没想好要不要跟你去呢。
items.py: Xiǎolì: Wǒ hái méi xiǎnghǎo yào bu yào gēn nǐ qù ne.
items.en: Xiaoli: I haven't decided yet whether I want to go with you.

data.topic: 课文2 · 2. 在家 — At home

items.en: all the time
game
homework
worried, anxious
to review

items.zh: 妈妈：你一直玩儿电脑游戏，作业写完了吗？
items.py: Māma: Nǐ yīzhí wánr diànnǎo yóuxì, zuòyè xiěwán le ma?
items.en: Mom: You've been playing computer games all the time. Have you finished your homework?
Son: I've finished all of it.

items.zh: 妈妈：明天不是有考试吗？你怎么一点儿也不着急？
items.py: Māma: Míngtiān bù shì yǒu kǎoshì ma? Nǐ zěnme yīdiǎnr yě bù zháojí?
items.en: Mom: Don't you have an exam tomorrow? How come you're not worried at all?

items.py: Érzi: Wǒ zǎo jiù fùxí hǎo le.
items.en: Son: I finished reviewing long ago.

items.zh: 妈妈：那也不能一直玩儿啊。
items.py: Māma: Nà yě bù néng yīzhí wánr a.
items.en: Mom: Even so, you can't play all the time.

data.topic: 课文3 · 3. 聊旅游计划 — Talking about the travel plan

items.en: south, southern part
north, northern part

items.zh: 小丽：下个月我去旅游，你能跟我一起去吗？
items.py: Xiǎolì: Xià ge yuè wǒ qù lǚyóu, nǐ néng gēn wǒ yīqǐ qù ma?
items.en: Xiaoli: I'm going travelling next month. Can you come with me?

items.zh: 小刚：我还没想好呢。你觉得哪儿最好玩儿？
items.py: Xiǎogāng: Wǒ hái méi xiǎnghǎo ne. Nǐ juéde nǎr zuì hǎowánr?
items.en: Xiaogang: I haven't decided yet. Where do you think is the most fun?

items.zh: 小丽：南方啊，我们去年就是这个时候去的。
items.py: Xiǎolì: Nánfāng a, wǒmen qùnián jiù shì zhège shíhou qù de.
items.en: Xiaoli: The south! We went at exactly this time last year.

items.zh: 小刚：南方太热了，北方好一些，不冷也不热。
items.py: Xiǎogāng: Nánfāng tài rè le, běifāng hǎo yīxiē, bù lěng yě bù rè.
items.en: Xiaogang: The south is too hot. The north is a bit better: neither cold nor hot.

data.topic: 课文4 · 4. 准备去旅游 — Preparing for their trip

items.en: bread
to take along, to bring
map
to move, to carry

items.zh: 小刚：水果、面包、茶都准备好了，我们还带什么？
items.py: Xiǎogāng: Shuǐguǒ, miànbāo, chá dōu zhǔnbèi hǎo le, wǒmen hái dài shénme?
items.en: Xiaogang: The fruit, bread and tea are all ready. What else should we bring?

items.zh: 小丽：手机、电脑、地图，一个也不能少。
items.py: Xiǎolì: Shǒujī, diànnǎo, dìtú, yī ge yě bù néng shǎo.
items.en: Xiaoli: Phone, computer, map: we can't leave a single one behind.

items.zh: 小刚：这些我昨天下午就准备好了。
items.py: Xiǎogāng: Zhèxiē wǒ zuótiān xiàwǔ jiù zhǔnbèi hǎo le.
items.en: Xiaogang: I already got those ready yesterday afternoon.

items.zh: 小丽：再多带几件衣服吧。
items.py: Xiǎolì: Zài duō dài jǐ jiàn yīfu ba.
items.en: Xiaoli: Bring a few more pieces of clothing.

items.zh: 小刚：我们是去旅游，不是搬家，还是少带一些吧。
items.py: Xiǎogāng: Wǒmen shì qù lǚyóu, bù shì bān jiā, háishi shǎo dài yīxiē ba.
items.en: Xiaogang: We're going on a trip, not moving house. Let's bring a bit less.
